_about: Public-domain John Wilkins (1614-1672), Bishop of Chester and founder of the Royal Society, for the Word Hoard: his theological works, Sermons Preach'd upon Several Occasions (1701), A Discourse concerning the Gift of Prayer (1704) and Of the Principles and Duties of Natural Religion (1734), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wilkins-sermons-1701: Sermons preach'd upon several occasions (London : Printed for Ri. Chiswell, Will. Battersby, and Will. Rogers, 1701)
wilkins-gift-of-prayer-1704: A Discourse concerning the gift of prayer : shewing what it is, wherein it consists, and how far it is attainable by industry ; with divers useful and proper directions to that purpose, both in respect of matter, method, expression (London : Printed for J. Lawrence [etc.], 1704)
wilkins-natural-religion-1734: Of the principles and duties of natural religion : two books (London : Printed for J. Walthoe, J. Knapton [etc.], 1734)

_alternates.wilkins-copies: Other printings of each (1718 Gift of Prayer and others)

_excluded.wilkins-secular: His natural philosophy (The Discovery of a World in the Moone 1638, Mathematicall Magick 1648, Mercury 1641/1694, the Mathematical and Philosophical Works 1708, 1802): outside lane A's theology scope
